title: Roof Replacement in Portland, OR
summary: In July 2024, French Roofing replaced the roof on a home in Portland, OR. The crew tore off the single layer of old shingles from the steep 8/12 pitch roof, laid Safeguard 30 hybrid underlayment, and installed new CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles with new plastic roof vents and ridge cap.
scope: Tore off the one layer of old shingles on an 8/12 pitch roof, down to the wood deck
Laid Safeguard 30 hybrid underlayment over the deck
Installed new CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles with standard ridge cap
Replaced the attic vents with new plastic vents and put new double-seal flashings on the vent pipes

faqs.question: How many layers of old roofing came off?
faqs.answer: One. The crew tore off the single layer of old shingles down to the wood deck before the new underlayment and shingles went on.
